name: costa_run
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / production game sprite animation. Create a BRAND NEW run-cycle sprite atlas for SUYURUN Tayta, NOT variants of the same pose. Image1 (actual Sierra gameplay run) is the PRIMARY guide for leg anatomy, athletic lean proportion and actual running biomechanics. Image2 is the Costa clothing/face reference ONLY; do NOT copy its repeated leg poses or enormous boots. Image3 actual Selva gameplay is additional anatomy reference. EXACTLY16 WHOLE-BODY FRAMES arranged4columns4rows with generous transparent gutters, no overlap, uniform scale, consistent HIP/Pelvis center and head size, all facing RIGHT. Lean human Tayta, warm human face, orange chullo pompom/compact orange poncho turquoise embroidery, dark teal fitted trousers (not baggy balloons), compact brown boots, BOTH ARMS HIDDEN under the poncho. Matte rich crisp 16/32bit pixel art native clusters, existing ochre teal terracotta purple palette. CRITICAL RUN SEQUENCE: frame0 near/front leg reaches forward heel strike, far leg extended backward toe off. 1 near knee compresses accepting body weight. 2 body down stance with far heel folds toward butt. 3 far thigh swings forward UNDER the pelvis, near foot travels backward relative to hip. 4 far knee raised AHEAD and near leg pushes BACK, trailing heel rises. 5 near leg extended behind in toe-off, far knee extends forward. 6 BOTH feet airborne, far foot reaching FORWARD while near heel is folded BACK. 7 descent to far foot strike. Frame8 FAR leg forward heel strike, NEAR leg straight behind. 9 far stance knee compresses with near heel folding high behind.10 near thigh passes beneath pelvis.11 near knee swings ahead, far supporting foot travels behind.12 near knee raised ahead, far leg toe push.13 far toe-off with near lower leg reaching.14 BOTH feet airborne near leg extended forward, far heel folds backward.15 descent to near heel strike, seamless match to0. Distinguish near leg brightly lit and far leg darker at every frame. Leg silhouettes MUST change front/back completely every half-cycle: no eight identical poses, no skating, no same forward boot in all frames. Hips show a tiny down/up arc, torso mild stable forward tilt, fabric hem/pompom drag by one frame. Actual joints, knees bend naturally. Both feet contact a shared virtual ground line only on CONTACT frames0/8, flight frames visibly ABOVE that line with toes 6-10pixels higher; equal-sized virtual frame boxes not drawn. NO shadows, dust, motion lines, scenery, lettering, grid or antialias blur. True transparent background.
